text.en: Variable trigger. Press and release to fire individual shots. Hold to charge up a high-powered, [Stagger] stunning laser. Strong against Unstoppable Champions.

Intrinsically <unstoppable/>Anti-Unstoppable in both modes.

Kills spawn a <solar/>Firesprite.

After picking up a <solar/>Firesprite, hold [Reload] to enable a Charged Laser. Charged Laser fires for 0.93 seconds at 1000 RPM and hits 15 times.

//Laser ticks deal 23% more damage than single shots, but that's kinda irrelevant?

Kills spawn a <solar/>Firesprite.

After picking up a <solar/>Firesprite, hold [Reload] to enable a Charged Laser. Charged Laser fires for 0.93 seconds at 1000 RPM and hits 15 times.

Hits against <strand/>Suspended enemies inflicts 20 Scorch (30 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes).

Kills spawn a <solar/>Firesprite.

After picking up a <solar/>Firesprite, hold [Reload] to enable a Charged Laser. Charged Laser takes 0.5 seconds to charge, at which point it fires for 0.93 seconds at 1000 RPM and hits 15 times.
